about: Scoring cases that BOTH engines must pass: Android/shared (ScoringCasesTest.kt) and iOS (iOS/Tests/EngineChecks). Add a case here whenever a rule changes. Taps: +1, -1, HR, OC, HR+1..HR+3, undo; 'x' repeats, e.g. '+1x11'. Dates are local time.

tallies.name: indoor custom HR and OC values
indoor undo removes the last tap
outdoor ignores the indoor HR value
